name: Apple Chicken Burger with Cranberry Mayo & Roasted Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until broccoli is fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; coarsely grate. Place in a large bowl, along with chicken, bread crumbs, and spices, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Gala apples
0.68 kg ground chicken
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp sage, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, mince cranberries. Place in a small bowl, along with mayo and spices, then stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup dried cranberries
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 pinch garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spread cranberry mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties, then close with the top half of each bun. Serve with roasted broccoli on the side and enjoy!
